name: PayU API
tagline: CEE and global payments with cards and local methods
description: PayU provides a payment gateway API for card processing, local payment methods, and multi-market checkout across Central and Eastern Europe and other regions. Merchants create orders, process payments, and manage refunds via REST endpoints.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant; access token used as Bearer token

use_cases: create a payment order for checkout
authorize OAuth access token for merchant API
capture or refund a completed payment
list available payment methods for a market
